cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative 70B four-bit dense memory budget. Weights 32.5963 GiB, assumed metadata 3.2596 GiB, runtime and OS reserve 16 GiB. FP16 KV: 80 layers, 8 KV heads, 128 head dimensions. Cases: 8192x1 = 54.3559 GiB, 32768x1 = 61.8559 GiB, 8192x4 = 61.8559 GiB, 32768x4 = 91.8559 GiB. Not measured hardware usage or a GPU memory limit.
